messages:
maya: Heads-up: planning cohorted launch posts for Redwood Inference next Tue/Wed. Goal: 3 staggered X threads + 2 LinkedIn posts targeting dev and product audiences. Need final copy + hero GIF by EOD Thu.

sam: Can we stagger by timezone? NA morning, EU afternoon, APAC evening worked well last quarter.

lina: Agreed. Different CTAs per cohort: sandbox signups for NA, case study download for EU, webinar invite for APAC.

maya: Rough schedule:
```
Cohort NA: X thread 10:00 PT -> CTA: sandbox signup
Cohort EU: X thread 14:00 CET -> CTA: case study
Cohort APAC: LinkedIn post 18:00 JST -> CTA: webinar
```

maya: Assets needed: 1 short carousel GIF, 2 hero images, 3 tweet-sized variants per thread node, webinar landing link. @ana can you confirm creative ETA?

ana: (ana) I can deliver GIF + 2 images by Thu afternoon. Need final copy ASAP and any benchmark charts.

maya: Creative brief: focus on "predictable latency" + simple cost delta chart. Palette: product blue + dark slate. GIF frames: 1) logo intro, 2) throughput snapshot, 3) CTA slide.

sam: Copy direction: short hook + benchmark stat + clear CTA. X opener idea: "Cut inference costs by ~40% without sacrificing latency — here's how. \u2193" then thread with benchmark details.

lina: For LinkedIn, longer post with customer quote + 3 bulletized benefits. Ill draft and share.

maya: Routing: webinar CTA -> SDR cohort A (sdr-na@redwood) for APAC signups; case study CTA -> sales-ops nurture queue. Need Zapier mapping and UTMs.

devon: Ill set up the Zap mapping. Confirm UTM scheme: utm_source=x|linkedin, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=cohort-launch-171705, utm_content=na_thread|eu_thread|apac_linkedin. Also include creative var param (cv=gif_v1|hero_v2).

sam: Add fallback: if thread interactions <200 within 24h, auto-boost top node ($500) and re-post with alternate hook after 18h. ops-bot, please create alert.

ops-bot: Alert created: monitor campaign "cohort-launch-171705" engagement. Threshold=200 interactions/24h. Notify @maya @sam @lina when below threshold.

ana: Posting cadence question: publish LinkedIn and X simultaneously for APAC or stagger?

maya: Stagger by 30 minutes: X first, LinkedIn 30m later to reduce overlap.

lina: Draft is live in Drive: https://drive.google.com/example-cohort-draft. Drop feedback there.

maya: Final checklist: copy (lina) Wed EOD, assets (ana) Thu EOD, UTM & Zap (devon) Thu EOD, queue posts Fri morning. Ping for blockers. :rocket:

sam: Also recommend saving 2 alternate hooks for rapid A/B if needed. Ill prepare 4 quick variants.

lina: Will add alt hooks + 1 shorter data visual for X thread.

maya: Great. We'll reconvene Fri AM to confirm scheduling.
